mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains less negative while TRANSIT rebounds, commuting activity will increase weekday trips into commercial areas and push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -33.4 to -18.6 while TRANSIT improved from -10.7 to -2.4 in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days despite a sustained 2-week improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A high RESIDENTIAL reading above the recent range indicates more time spent near home, which suppresses discretionary shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays at or above 5 points above baseline for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive at 6.3, 5.1, 8.7, and 5.0 across the four observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays above the prior 4-week mean after RESIDENTIAL remains elevated for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays strongly positive while PARKS remains depressed, errands are concentrated in essential trips rather than leisure shopping, keeping RETAIL_REC below the recent average over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM remained well above baseline while PARKS stayed negative in all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM remains elevated and PARKS remains negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT signals tighter mobility conditions that directly reduce access to shopping districts, causing RETAIL_REC to fall in the following week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after TRANSIT drops by more than 5 points from one week to the next.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS remain seasonally weak while retail activity is also below baseline, outdoor discretionary movement is not spilling into shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC stays weak over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS stayed between -25.4 and -21.6 while RETAIL_REC stayed between -14.0 and -10.1 in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while PARKS remains negative for the entire next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A broad improvement in all movement categories, especially WORKPLACES and TRANSIT, reflects resumption of normal circulation that lifts shopping traffic with a four-week lag.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improved from t-1w to t-0w after a very weak t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over the next 28 days despite concurrent improvement in WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and GROCERY_PHARM.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was much lower than TRANSIT in t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though WORKPLACES remains at least 10 points below TRANSIT for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: During a mobility reopening, a rebound in TRANSIT above its recent trough acts first, then retail follows after roughly one month; the effect is absent if transit remains near zero change.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from its prior week trough
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -10.7 to -2.4 after hitting a recent low
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days after TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from its prior-week trough.
